mapper.select: SELECT P.NO, P.NAME, P.GENDER, P.AGE, p.phone, P.LOCATION, LAST_RESERV, NEXT_RESERV, D.NAME D_NAME FROM PATIENT P INNER JOIN DOCTOR D ON P.DC_NO = D.NO ORDER BY P.NO ASC
SELECT P.NO, P.NAME, P.GENDER, P.BIRTH_YEAR, P.AGE, p.phone, P.LOCATION, LAST_RESERV, NEXT_RESERV, D.NAME D_NAME FROM PATIENT P INNER JOIN DOCTOR D ON P.DC_NO = D.NO WHERE P.NO = #{no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PATIENT VALUES(PATIENT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{name}, #{birthYear}, NULL, 0, #{phone}, #{location}, null, null, #{doctor.no})
